WTRN-002.scenario: Verify that the Transfers list page opens
WTRN-002.preconditions: Admin is signed in to the console.
steps: Wait for the page to finish loading.
WTRN-002.expected: The Transfers page loads without error and the transfers table (or an empty list) is shown.

WTRN-004/005.scenario: Verify that clicking a pending transfer opens its Transfer Journey showing its details and approval steps
WTRN-004/005.preconditions: Admin is signed in. At least one transfer with status 'Pending for Authorization' exists (otherwise skipped).
steps: Open the Transfers page and wait for it to load.
Click the first 'Pending for Authorization' status badge.
Read the Transfer Journey panel that opens.
WTRN-004/005.test_data: First transfer in 'Pending for Authorization' status
WTRN-004/005.expected: The Transfer Journey shows the transfer details and approval progress (Transfer ID, amount, Maker, Approver).

WTRN-011.scenario: Check that a user without approval rights does not see the Approve button
WTRN-011.preconditions: A limited-role (non-admin) user's credentials are set up (otherwise skipped). At least one pending transfer exists.
steps: Sign in as the limited-role user.
Open the Transfers page and wait for it to load.
Click the first 'Pending for Authorization' status badge.
Look for an Approve button in the Transfer Journey.
WTRN-011.expected: No visible, enabled Approve button is shown to this user.

WTRN-009.scenario: Check that the maker who created a transfer cannot approve the same transfer
WTRN-009.preconditions: A transfer created by the maker user must exist. Note: this test is currently skipped in automation because no such transfer is set up yet (Create Transfer is not live).
steps: Sign in as the maker user who created the transfer.
Open the Transfers page and open that transfer's Transfer Journey.
WTRN-009.test_data: A transfer created by the maker user
WTRN-009.expected: The maker cannot approve their own transfer (not yet automated; test is skipped).

WTRN-014.scenario: Verify that no full bank account number is shown in the Transfer Journey
WTRN-014.preconditions: Admin is signed in. At least one pending transfer exists (otherwise skipped).
steps: Open the Transfers page and wait for it to load.
Click the first 'Pending for Authorization' status badge.
Read all text in the Transfer Journey panel.
WTRN-014.expected: No plain number of 9 to 18 digits (a full account number) appears; account numbers are masked.
